verified_integrations.name: tftp-parser-differential-conformance
verified_integrations.scope: Real-process differential conformance for toy_tcpip::tftp::TftpPacket::parse against an independent Python oracle, covering reviewed valid/malformed TFTP packets plus a deterministic exhaustive single-bit mutation schedule over representative RRQ, ACK, and ERROR seeds.
verification_contract: Rust 1.88 adapter formatting and Clippy -D warnings
build the adapter against the imported toy_tcpip crate
ruff-check the independent oracle and integration tests
DifferentialHarness executes the Rust candidate and Python oracle as real subprocess targets
reviewed valid and malformed TFTP corpus must produce equivalent canonical semantic results
DeterministicByteMutations plus run_fuzz_campaign must exhaust the representative single-bit mutation schedule without a product mismatch or infrastructure failure
limitations: does not claim whole-stack or whole-RFC TFTP conformance
does not exercise UDP sockets, packet transport, file transfer, or TFTP server behavior
does not prove MinIOS networking or container networking interoperability
does not make security or performance claims
